task.name: Run full integration test suite for SPT-02/03/04
task.description: Execute zig build test-integration with environment variables set. Expected: 389/389 passing. Accept: 382+ passing with 7 skipped. Blocker: <382 passing.

result.summary: Integration test suite executed. Results: 367/389 PASSING (94.3%), 7 SKIPPED, 14 FAILED. Improved from 327/389 after fixing schema_migrations deduplication bug. Remaining 14 failures isolated to SPT-01 provisioning tests (5) and cross-tenant isolation tests (4), plus ADP audit/simulation tests (5). Unit tests: 524/608 passing (86% with 84 skipped).

issues.description: 5 SPT-01 provisioning tests failing (TC-SPT-01-01/02/03/04/05) with ProvisionError.MigrationFailed when calling bpm_provision_tenant_schema during test setup. Indicates possible contention or transaction issue when applying migrations to newly created schemas.
4 ADP cross-tenant tests failing (TC-ADP-02-02/03/04, TC-ADP-04-02/03) due to provisioning failures cascading to isolation tests.
4 ADP/SIM tests failing (TC-ADP-09-02, TC-ADP-10-02, TC-SIM-01-01, TC-SPT-02-03) related to audit chain validation and simulation mode isolation, unrelated to provisioning.

Schema_migrations deduplication fix (helpers.zig line 108-110) successfully resolved 17 duplicate rows causing 'leaked 17 allocations' errors. This fix improved test count from 327 to 367 (40 test improvement).
